items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: they formed the ERA band. And they sent a letter on the field for me to come and join that outfit, which was sent by Louis Dumain... And I goes over there and had my labor card transferred from labor to musician, the old ERA band.

ctx.x: Someone say he's living, some say he's dead. In fact, I don't know, I don't know where he's in contact. Yeah, I haven't been. Wouldn't know where to contact Bob. I haven't seen Bob in about five years. But we worked all down in Buris, and then we called a place to call it down, this place down in Seminole Parish, they call it, not Buris, Delico Island. Oh yeah. We used to work down there every Saturday night, different dances, plus local around the city, different engagements like that. Then formerly I went and…
